ModManifest.Description:
### 《自由聊天&议价&交换》
随心所欲，畅所欲言！
哄骗一些顾客，威胁一些改造体，辱骂一位房东
你是合格的商人吗？
发挥你的三寸不烂之舌，让顾客同意你的报价
没有信用点？那就交换！
拿假标签纯水交换他们的AI模组吧！
### 主要功能
- 店内顾客与电话联系人自由聊天 - 自由议价：折扣、加价和目标价格 - 精确物品交换，区分顾客物品与玩家物品 - 支持“物品 + 信用点”的混合交换 - 顾客明确补款时，从顾客预算结算给玩家 - 查看和展示顾客真实携带的物品 - 找货委托与未来回访 - 第三方传话任务，目标人物会自行接受或拒绝 - 顾客明确告别时自动离店，电话联系人明确结束时自动挂断 - 支持临时变化、跨天事件、到期恢复和公开新闻投影
### 配置要求
需要在游戏内按 `F10` 配置 OpenAI 兼容模型接口。接口不可用时会自动使用本地预置回复。
自由聊天会将必要的对话和交易上下文发送到你配置的服务。请根据服务商的隐私政策和计费规则使用。
---
### Free Chat & Bargaining & Barter
Talk freely and say whatever you want!
Persuade some customers, threaten some augmented people, insult a landlord.
Are you a qualified merchant?
Use your silver tongue to get customers to accept your offer.
No credits? Then barter!
Trade purified water with a fake label for their AI modules!
### Main Features
- Free conversation with shop customers and phone contacts - Bargaining with discounts, markups, and target prices - Precise item barter with verified customer and player ownership - Mixed trades using items plus credits - Customer-to-player credit transfers from the customer's budget - Reveal and display real items carried by customers - Future item sourcing requests and return visits - Third-party contact tasks with independent target decisions - Automatic customer departure and phone call ending - Temporary changes, cross-day events, expiry restoration, and public news projection
### Requirements
Press `F10` in-game to configure an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint. Local fallback replies are used when the configured service is unavailable.
Conversation and necessary trade context are sent to the service you configure. Check that provider's privacy policy and billing terms before use.
